name: Lying Cable Preacher Curl
description: A bicep isolation exercise performed lying face-down on an incline bench with a cable attached below, curling the bar upward. The prone position eliminates the ability to use body swing and keeps the shoulder in a consistent position, targeting the biceps through a unique angle that changes the peak contraction point.

execution.starting_position: Set an incline bench in front of a low cable pulley. Lie face-down on the bench with arms hanging down toward the cable attachment. Grip a curl bar or rope.
execution.setup_instructions: Attach a straight bar or EZ bar to the low pulley. Set an incline bench at 30 to 45 degrees. Lie prone on the bench with arms hanging toward the pulley.
steps: Step 1: Keeping the upper arms stationary hanging straight down, curl the bar upward.
Step 2: Curl to full bicep flexion at the top.
Step 3: Slowly lower back to full arm extension.
Step 4: Repeat without letting the upper arm move.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl up. Inhale on the controlled descent.
common_mistakes: Allowing the upper arms to swing forward during the curl
Using too heavy a load for this strict position
safety_considerations: The prone position is strict — start lighter than expected
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the bottom. Full flexion at the top.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the bicep at the top
